In Banking & Financial Services, quantum & advanced compute is the frontier tower, run with a pragmatist's discipline. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: quantum readiness & strategy, quantum optimization for enterprise problems, post-quantum cryptography migration — delivered on Dataq Quanta and Dataq Sentinel with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure

Long-lived client records, interbank traffic and archived communications face retrospective decryption risk as quantum timelines shorten. Cryptographic inventory is incomplete; migration has no owner and no clock.
KYC and periodic-review backlog

Customer due diligence refresh cycles lag behind actual risk changes; files queue for weeks in review pools while remediation backlogs grow. Manual file assembly across registries, screening tools and core systems consumes analyst hours that produce no judgment.
GenAI stuck between pilot and policy

Generative assistants for credit memos, research summaries and client drafts stall in model-risk review because guardrails, provenance and audit trails were not designed in. Shadow AI fills the gap, creating exactly the exposure the review was meant to prevent.

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: PSD2 / PSD3 and instant payments and DORA (EU). ICT risk, incident reporting, resilience testing and third-party oversight obligations with supervisory scrutiny. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

Every program of this type runs the same weekly rhythm, so your team can plan around it. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
